P.C. :
1) Husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law and brother-in-law of Respondent No.2 respectively, have filed present Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of R.C.C. No. 106 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class (Court No.3), Kalyan, arising out of CR No. 941 of 2023 dated Pankaj Ashok Sharma And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124794905/
1 15 th November 2023 registered with Manpada Police Station, Dombivali, District Thane, under Sections 377, Osk 40-Wp-86-2024.doc 498A, 323, 504 & 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code (I.P.C.) with the consent of Respondent No.2, the informant.
2) Learned Advocate for Respondent No.2 submitted that, the Respondent No.2 has filed on record an Affidavit dated 2 nd July 2024 duly affirmed before a Notary Public.

sentences.text: In para No.10 thereof, she has given her consent for quashing of the said case.
2.1) Respondent No.2 is personally present in the Court and through her Advocate reiterates the contents of her Affidavit dated 2 nd July 2024 and her 'no objection' for quashing of the said case.

3) In view thereof, the Petition is allowed in terms of amended prayer clause (aa).
